description: Find messages by meaning and by words at once, in every chat or one: a paraphrase still hits; another language seldom does, so ask in the chat's language. match: "words" for exact words (a number, URL). since, until, from narrow it; full_text: whole texts; coverage, freshness: how much was searched.

chat_id.description: Chat id, or a phone number

from.description: "me", a number, an id, or a name only one person has

full_text.description: Each message's text whole; a list cuts long ones otherwise

name: search

coverage.description: null: it could not be counted

from_index.description: Kept only as text: no media, reply or forward

mode.description: keyword_fallback: meaning search could not run, see recall_unavailable

notes.description: Caveats to act on or tell the user

private_omitted.description: Matches from people tagged #private, left out: chat_id or from shows them

scan_capped.description: Older matches may be missing: narrow the search

searched_back_to.description: Older messages were not searched: narrow the search

title: Search WhatsApp messages
